questions.title: 1. My best ideas at work come from

selections.text: Discussing and sharing ideas with others.
selections.aiPrompt: Extroverted (E): Gains energy and inspiration through interaction with the outside world, good at social communication, values teamwork, likes to spark creativity in discussions, suitable for work environments requiring interpersonal interaction.

Introverted (I): Gains energy and inspiration through internal reflection, good at independent work, values deep thinking, likes quiet and focused environments, more suitable for work requiring concentration.

questions.title: 2. When I chair a meeting, I usually

selections.text: Stick strictly to the agenda I prepared in advance.
selections.aiPrompt: Judging (J): Tends to handle matters in a planned and organized way, values results and efficiency, likes to complete tasks step by step, organized and clear goals.

selections.text: Am more flexible and open to whatever comes up.
selections.aiPrompt: Perceiving (P): Tends to adapt flexibly to changes, values process and possibilities, likes to improvise, open to new things, more creative and adaptable.

questions.title: 3. When dealing with subordinates' development, I am most likely to

selections.aiPrompt: Thinking (T): Tends to focus on objective facts and logical analysis, handles problems based on reason and principles, values fairness and consistency, good at finding the root cause of problems.
Feeling (F): Tends to focus on others' feelings and relationships, handles problems with consideration and harmony, values team members' feelings, good at maintaining harmonious relationships.

questions.title: 4. I prefer my workplace to be

selections.text: Structured with clear rules and regulations.
selections.aiPrompt: Judging (J): Prefers orderly and predictable environments, values structure and norms, likes clear guidelines, performs better in environments with clear rules.
Perceiving (P): Prefers free and flexible environments, values autonomy and creativity, likes more space for self-expression, strong adaptability.

questions.title: 5. I would prefer a supervisor who interacts with me

selections.aiPrompt: Extroverted (E): Needs frequent social interaction to maintain energy, likes teamwork and communication-intensive environments, more active in teams with rich interpersonal relationships.
Introverted (I): Prefers less disturbance and more independent work space, needs time to focus on thinking, likes autonomous working methods, more efficient in quiet environments.

questions.title: 6. When making decisions, I tend to

selections.text: Base them on objective facts and logical analysis.
selections.aiPrompt: Thinking (T): Values rational analysis in decision-making, based on data and facts, pursues objectivity and fairness, good at discovering the key and essence of problems.
Feeling (F): Values human factors in decision-making, considers the impact on others, pursues harmonious coexistence, good at handling interpersonal relationships, values team cohesion.

questions.title: 7. When facing new challenges, I usually

selections.aiPrompt: Judging (J): Likes to solve problems in an organized way, values structure and planning, tends to advance step by step, more efficient in orderly environments.

selections.text: Adapt to changes and go with the flow.
selections.aiPrompt: Perceiving (P): Likes to respond flexibly, values adaptability and improvisation, good at seizing sudden opportunities, performs better in changing environments.

questions.title: 8. In social situations, I tend to

selections.text: Initiate conversations with strangers and expand my social circle.
selections.aiPrompt: Extroverted (E): Active and proactive in social situations, enjoys interacting with people, good at building new relationships, gains energy and motivation in interpersonal interactions.

selections.text: Have deep conversations with familiar friends.
selections.aiPrompt: Introverted (I): Prefers deep communication in social situations, values quality over quantity, likes to build deep relationships with a few people, more comfortable in familiar environments.
